meta.criterion: |T_built(h) - T_raw(h)| / T_raw(h) < 5.0 % for every h on all ten airfoils
meta.units: lengths in the D25 chord of the raw file (c); kappa in 1/c; T in degrees
meta.sigma: arc length from the Stage 1 LE point (farthest raw point from the TE midpoint), + upper, - lower
meta.tangent_tilt_at_le_deg: turning of the raw spline between its apex and the LE point (> 0: apex on the lower side)
meta.loft_backend: numpy (pyGeo not installed); built_avg checks the other knot rule
